items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Paul Jones and Harry Curtis, who was playing first alto... And I was playing trumpet... That was that band.

ctx.x: Who was in it when you were there?

It wasn't as big a band as... That band wasn't; it was a smaller band. Paul Jones and Harry Curtis, who was playing first alto. John Malachi on piano. Tommy on drums. Benny Fonville playing bass. Chester Brown was playing guitar. Good one, too; he died. Good guitar player, man. He was way ahead of his time. Chester Brown on guitar. And Pete Jones playing trombone. Reds McCurry was playing trumpet. And I was playing trumpet and Jefferson also. We had Pete Jones on trombone. And that was it. That was that band.
